mainEntity.name: What is an AI search visibility agency and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: An AI search visibility agency helps your startup appear as the cited answer when buyers ask ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google AI Mode questions in your category. It is for Web3, AI agent, DePIN and cybersecurity founders who know that a growing share of their buyers now start with a prompt, not a search bar. The work combines citation-ready content, targeted press placements in outlets AI engines trust, and structured schema so engines can extract clean answers. Shilika Jain runs this directly for $5K–$12K/month.

mainEntity.name: How much does AI search visibility work cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A monthly retainer covering citation audits, content production, schema implementation and press placement support runs $5K–$12K/month for a fractional senior operator. A full agency offering the same scope typically charges $15K–$45K/month because the model funds a multi-person account team. A focused launch sprint, building out the content architecture and seeding the first press citations, runs $15K–$40K over four to eight weeks.

mainEntity.name: Which outlets and deliverables are included?

acceptedAnswer.text: Press placements target the outlets AI engines draw from most heavily for Web3 and tech: Forbes, CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, Decrypt, The Block, Blockworks and Benzinga for crypto; Forbes, TechCrunch and AI Magazine for AI and DePIN. Content deliverables include long-form authority articles, FAQ-schema pages, founder op-eds, structured case studies and entity consolidation across Crunchbase and LinkedIn. The exact mix depends on where your citation gap is largest.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see AI citation results?

acceptedAnswer.text: First citations in Perplexity and Google AI Mode typically appear within four to eight weeks of publishing structured authority content that is backed by at least one tier-1 press placement. ChatGPT's training cycle is less predictable, but the same authority signals that drive Perplexity citations also improve ChatGPT results over time. The monthly citation sweep tracks progress every four weeks so you can see movement clearly.

Send a short project brief through the intent form and you will get a reply within 24 hours with a quick read on your current AI-engine presence and where the gaps are. Alternatively, book a 30-minute call and we will map it live. No deck required, no account-team intro call.
